about: Every name, description and grade is the official list as PlayStation publishes it. Every guide is written for this entry from the official description plus the PSN progress target where PSNProfiles lists one. Difficulty (1-5), time and hours are this entry's estimates, not official figures, and are labelled as estimates in the app. The game released 19 November 2026 and this guide has not been checked in the game: where a place or step is not pinned down by a source, the guide says so instead of inventing it. v3 adds, on every trophy, an availability window (when it can be earned and what closes it), its prerequisites, and an hour estimate that feeds the time-to-platinum estimator.
sources: Exophase official trophy list (exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies) — name, description and grade of every trophy
PSNProfiles official list (psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi) — grade and PSN progress target where one exists
Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game
estimatorMethod: Unfinished story chapters count 6 h each, the final mission 1 h; every other trophy counts its own hour estimate, and a counted trophy counts only the share still to do. Chapter trophies and the two sum trophies (100% completion, platinum) count 0 h of their own.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.time: Whole game — the longest road on the list
trophies.when: Last — it unlocks when the other 54 are earned
trophies.windowCloses: Never — it lands when the other 54 are earned
prerequisites: Earn the other 54 trophies
Attain 100% completion (A Long Road)
sources: Exophase official trophy list — name, description, grade
PSNProfiles official list — grade
Own advice from the official description — not yet checked in the game
trophies.guide: The platinum. It unlocks when the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task: follow the roadmap in order — story first, then side characters, activities, collectibles and money — and this one lands last. Keep the two gold trophies in view, because they are the longest poles on the road: the final mission and 100% completion. The pre-finale checklist is the single most valuable habit on this list: finish every story-locked and missable trophy before the final mission, so the post-game is cleanup, not a second playthrough.
steps: Work the roadmap in stage order — story, side strands, activities, collectibles, money.
Before the final mission, clear the pre-finale checklist in full.
Treat 100% completion as the last job before the platinum.
Use the tracker after every session so nothing slips: tick trophies, log counters, write notes.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.when: Any time — build it passively, grind the rest after the story

PSNProfiles official list — grade and PSN progress target (250)

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. PSN tracks the count to 250, so the target is fixed and progress is cumulative across the whole game — nothing says the stunts must happen in one session or one place. Build the count passively while travelling between missions: take jumps, thread traffic and catch air whenever the road offers it, and let the counter climb. The description does not define what counts as a stunt, so treat jumps, near-misses and air time as candidates and check the in-game counter before grinding the remainder in one spot. Save the deliberate grind for the post-game, when the count is nearly there.
steps: Drive with intent between missions: jumps, near-misses, air time.
Log your count in the tracker so you know how far is left.
After the story, grind the remainder in one spot with repeatable jumps.
Check the in-game counter to confirm what actually counts as a stunt.
